title: Sex-related Variability of White-Matter Tracts is Robust to Tractography Methodology
authors: Matthew Amandola, Bastien Herlin, Michael E. Kim, Simon Vandekar, Ivy Uszynski, Bennett Landman, Cyril Poupon, Kurt G. Schilling
summary: Two tractography pipelines yielded similar estimates of sex differences in white matter microstructure. Differences were more frequent for normalized tract volume.
description: The authors ran two probabilistic tractography pipelines on the same Human Connectome Project data. Only one of 343 microstructural comparisons showed a statistically significant disagreement. Eight of the nine significant disagreements concerned normalized tract volume. The comparison does not establish agreement for deterministic tractography.
findings: Only one of 343 microstructural comparisons significantly disagreed between pipelines.
Normalized pathway volume accounted for eight of the nine significant disagreements.
